Retirees::DI2.formula: IF(DH2="D","Your current monthly benefit of $"&TEXT(BN2,"0000.00")&" will decrease to $"&TEXT(BY2,"0000.00")&" because of the limitations placed on the monthly benefit payable at DOPT. See the Benefit Calculation section for further details.","NULL")

Retirees::DJ2.formula: IF(DH2="D","The benefits PBGC guarantees are limited by federal pension law to PBGC's maximum monthly amount that was in effect on the date of plan termination. This amount is adjusted to reflect the participant's age and form of annuity.","NULL")

Retirees::DK2.formula: IF(AND(DH2="D",BX2>0),"Under Section 4022(c) of ERISA, PBGC has allocated additional funds to non-guaranteed benefits based on PBGC's experience in recovering on claims against plan sponsors. PBGC has, therefore, increased your monthly benefit, as shown below.","NULL")

Terminated Vested::DM2.formula: IF(OR(AND(F2="XRD",G2="V"),CX2<=DE2),"NULL","The benefits PBGC guarantees are limited by federal pension law to PBGC's maximum monthly amount that was in effect on the date of plan termination. This amount is adjusted to reflect the participant's age and form of annuity.")

Terminated Vested::DN2.formula: IF(OR(AND(F2="XRD",G2="V"),DI2=0),"NULL","Under Section 4022(c) of ERISA, PBGC has allocated additional funds to non-guaranteed benefits based on PBGC's experience in recovering on claims against plan sponsors. PBGC has, therefore, increased your monthly benefit, as shown below.")

See the Benefit Calculation section for further details.",IF(ED2="N","Your current monthly benefit of $"&TEXT(IF(ISBLANK(EB2),EA2,EB2),"000.00")&" will not change.
